profile: architecture (paper combined objective); optional area diagnostic

timing_protocol.architecture_profile: Additional measured continuous-frame capacity tests with mixed gaps and dense reset probes; 384-cycle service remains mandatory

hardware.cell_library: ASAP7 RVT/TT combinational and sequential cells
hardware.hold_check: Minimum-delay STA must pass for every mapped implementation; default DC mapping includes incremental hold repair. Imported implementations are measured without repair or resynthesis.

interface.sampling: Inputs stable before rising edge; outputs observed after that edge; first input edge is cycle 0.

scoring.resolved: all selected-profile numerical, protocol, timing and RTL/mapped requirements pass; independent of score
scoring.area: clip((A_ref-A)/(A_ref-0.5*A_ref),0,1); A_ref is smallest validated accurate mapped area
scoring.frequency: architecture only: passing setup/hold endpoint from reconstraint and STA clock scan on fixed mapped netlist; 0.01ns bracket
scoring.throughput: STA-certified frequency divided by smallest measured long-tested integer II; never agent claim
scoring.latency_score: maximum observed first-output cycles times common 10 ns, reference 300 cycles
scoring.SQNR: hard constraint only; no bonus above threshold
scoring.missing_calibration: score_valid=false; hardware feasibility remains separately available
scoring.measurement_stage: pre-layout synthesis and ideal-interconnect STA; not post-route or silicon Fmax

verification.rtl: VCS four-state, ordinary unspecified initial state and synchronous-reset checks
verification.mapped: VCS four-state logic, full RTL comparison from three time-zero register initializations: all zero, all one, and seed 20261121
verification.initialization_scope: time zero only; no forcing or repair during reset, processing or output
verification.motivation: avoid false failures from reconvergent reset X-pessimism while requiring recovery from multiple physical binary initial states
verification.guarantee: empirical full-transaction RTL/netlist equivalence; optional formal proof is reported separately

evaluation.ii_search: all integers 64..384; optional shorter failures do not invalidate mandatory service

implementation.recipes: Optional editable flow/dc_opt.tcl, flow/yosys_opt.ys, flow/abc_opt.script; built in public development environment
implementation.artifact: Flattened structural ASAP7 RVT/TT netlist tied to the submitted RTL and supplied library source hashes
implementation.grading: Never execute agent Tcl/YS/ABC scripts in hidden grading; independently import/count/STA and compare mapped behavior to RTL
implementation.constraints: Same final library, corner, clock/I/O assumptions, numerical/protocol tests and score policy for all candidates
implementation.default: No custom recipe or artifact: use the provided default mapping recipe
implementation.pnr: Editable template only; not scored until a matched physical kit and post-route evaluation are provided
